FROM ubuntu:24.04

RUN apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=3 update \
    && apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=3 install -y --no-install-recommends openjdk-21-jdk-headless python3 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /opt/rocketbrain-fixture
COPY PortFixture.java .
RUN javac -g --add-modules jdk.httpserver PortFixture.java
